relations.name: invoice
relations.meaning: A represented billed-revenue invoice as recorded in billing sources with source-native identifiers and metadata.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/billing/invoices.json by invoice_id row.
relations.construction_rule: Parse invoices.json; mint one invoice referent per invoice_id; copy fields verbatim without normalization of identifiers.

relations.name: crm_account
relations.meaning: A CRM commercial account record as it appears in the authoritative CRM export.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/crm.csv by crm_account_id row.
relations.construction_rule: Parse crm.csv; mint one account referent per crm_account_id; render consumer identifiers as crm:<crm_account_id> when projecting to purpose B forms.

relations.name: registry_entity
relations.meaning: A company-registry legal entity row as recorded in the authoritative registry export.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/company_registry.csv by company_number row.
relations.construction_rule: Parse company_registry.csv; mint one entity referent per company_number; render consumer identifiers as registry:<company_number> when projecting to purpose B forms.

relations.name: contract
relations.meaning: A contract or statement-of-work document with source-native identifier and counterparty naming as it appears in the markdown header.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to one sources/contracts/*.md file; contract_id is filename stem.
relations.construction_rule: Enumerate contract markdown files; mint one contract referent per file; extract counterparty and document_kind from header lines without paraphrase.

relations.name: contract_term
relations.meaning: Observed effective, expiry, and free-text term language for a contract document as stated in source headers.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to the header term/effective/expiry lines of the corresponding contract markdown file.
relations.construction_rule: Parse Effective, Term, and Expiry header fields from contract markdown; leave expiry_date empty when not explicitly stated.

relations.name: contract_section
relations.meaning: A numbered or titled contractual section excerpt exactly as it appears in a source contract document.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to a specific ## section span in a contract markdown file.
relations.construction_rule: Split contract markdown on section headings; emit one tuple per section with heading and body text copied verbatim.

relations.name: contract_in_force
relations.meaning: Whether a contract is currently in force on the evaluation date according to its stated dates and term language, independent of any diligence purpose.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded evidence packet citing contract_term tuples and evaluation-date arithmetic; no closed-world default when term language is ambiguous.
relations.construction_rule: For each contract referent, assess in-force status from contract_term fields and section text; emit IN_FORCE or EXPIRED only when confident, otherwise UNRESOLVED via obligations.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per contract referent compiled in contract.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Term language (auto-renewal, rolling term, notice windows) does not deterministically establish in-force status on the evaluation date.

relations.name: clause_presence
relations.meaning: Whether a contract bears a specified clause kind under the analytical vocabulary requested by purposes A or C.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded evidence packet citing contract_section excerpts; absence of confident match is not evidence of absence.
relations.construction_rule: For each generated (contract, clause_kind) candidate, classify presence from section text; emit PRESENT only with supporting excerpt, otherwise UNRESOLVED.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Cartesian product of contract referents with the union of purpose A acquisition-relevant kinds and purpose C obligation kinds; purposes filter kinds at projection.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Section text is ambiguous, silent, or insufficient to classify the requested clause_kind under the purpose vocabulary.

relations.name: identity_judgment
relations.meaning: Two commercially relevant identifiers denote the same legal counterparty, are confidently distinct, or remain unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet. SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence, not compatibility. Similarity alone is insufficient.
relations.construction_rule: Resolve each candidate pair using authoritative source evidence; apply mechanical SAME_ENTITY only for exact legal-form variants of the same registered name; otherwise choose SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED with cited grounding.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Emit directed pairs from identity_candidate_pair plus mechanically detected exact legal-name variants within a relationship thread.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Authoritative sources do not confidently establish sameness or distinctness between the two identifiers.

relations.name: invoice_contract_association
relations.meaning: Whether a billed invoice can be confidently associated with a governing contract/counterparty thread for purpose A reporting.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet chaining invoice billed_name, contract counterparty_text, and purpose-B identity links; missing join evidence is not a negative finding.
relations.construction_rule: For each candidate (invoice, contract) in a commercial thread, assert association only when identity and relationship evidence supports a confident join; otherwise emit UNRESOLVED.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Pairs where invoice billed_name and contract counterparty participate in the same relationship-thread candidate set produced by identity_candidate_pair connectivity.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Billed name and contract counterparty cannot be confidently linked through resolved identity evidence.

relations.name: identity_candidate_pair
relations.meaning: A directed pair of purpose-B identifier strings that are comparable candidates within the same commercial relationship thread.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation inputs are compiled crm_account, invoice, contract, and registry_entity tuples plus filename/account-id correspondence heuristics.
relations.construction_rule: Derive directed identifier pairs needed to connect CRM, billing, contract, and registry candidates for each relationship thread without asserting sameness.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Group records by contract filename stem prefixes and CRM account ids; within each thread emit left/right pairs across crm:, billing:, contract:, and registry: identifier forms required for connectivity.

relations.name: open_invoice
relations.meaning: Invoices whose source status is open as recorded in billing data.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from invoice tuples where status equals open in sources.
relations.construction_rule: SELECT invoice referents from invoice where status = 'open'; copy invoice_id verbatim.

relations.name: contract_in_force_active
relations.meaning: Boolean projection of resolved contract_in_force judgments for consumer fields requiring semantic_identity active.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from contract_in_force tuples with dispositions IN_FORCE or EXPIRED only.
relations.construction_rule: Map IN_FORCE to active=true and EXPIRED to active=false; omit rows where contract_in_force is UNRESOLVED.

relations.name: commercial_dependency
relations.meaning: Purpose-C dependency row asserting dependent or unresolved status for a contract/counterparty thread under the joint current-relationship and obligation test.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from open_invoice, contract_in_force_active, clause_presence, and resolved identity_judgment inputs only.
relations.construction_rule: Emit dependent when (open invoice OR active auto-renewal/rolling contract) AND at least one qualifying obligation kind is PRESENT; emit unresolved when required identity or lifecycle inputs are unresolved; do not emit false negatives.

limitations: commercial_notes.md is excluded from world grounding; it may inform human review but not mechanical tuples.
Purpose D is out of scope for this vocabulary pass.
contract_in_force UNRESOLVED rows do not populate active; downstream purposes must treat missing active as blocking rather than false.
